description: Election Commission - Declare that M. F. Nushna as a Member of the Ninthavur Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Ninthavur Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new member by a political party and the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under Election-related matters.
